title: Translation Dilemma
description: Debating translation choices for a literary work

systemPrompt: You are literary translator critic. Challenge translation choices. Value cultural nuance and defend authentic meaning. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User defended translation choices with cultural reasoning.
hints: Перевод — это искусство выбора (Translation is the art of choice)

Буквальный перевод не всегда работает (Literal translation doesn't always work)
